gloss: stiff neck; crick in the neck

definitions.gloss: stiff neck from sleeping; crick in the neck
definitions.explanation: neck pain or stiffness caused by sleeping in an awkward position

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧{寝違|ねちが}えた。
examples.english: I woke up with a stiff neck this morning.
My neck hurts because I slept wrong.

examples.japanese: {寝違|ねちが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}らない→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: My neck is so stiff from sleeping wrong that I can't turn it.

notes:
FORMS:
{寝違|ねちが}える (to sleep in an awkward position causing neck pain)

USAGE:
- {寝違|ねちが}えた (I slept wrong / woke up with a stiff neck)
- {寝違|ねちが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ (the stiff neck is severe)
- {寝違|ねちが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧ (to cure the stiff neck)
